newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-ROSENBORG TRONDHEIM V AC MILAN TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROSENBORG TRONDHEIM V AC MILAN TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup match between Rosenborg Trondheim of Norway and AC Milan of Italy in group D of the Champions' League.

Rosenborg: 1-Joern Jamtfall; 9-Karl-Petter Loeken, 3-Erik Hoftun, 4-Bjoern Otto Bragstad, 5-Staale Stensaas; 6-Roar Strand, 8-Bent Skammelsrud, 20-Trond Egil Soltvedt; 11-Jahn Ivar Jakobsen, 10-Harald Brattbakk, 16-Steffen Iversen

AC Milan: 1-Sebastiano Rossi; 2-Christian Panucci, 11-Alessandro Costacurta, 8-Marcel Desailly, 3-Paolo Maldini; 22-Edgar Davids, 4-Demetrio Albertini, 15-Massimo Ambrosini, 10-Dejan Savicevic; 9-George Weah, 23-Marco Simone.
